item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, the Advanced Air Sealing upgrade:

- **Eligible homes:** Dwelling units with baseline air leakage of **6 ACH50 or greater**.
- **Target leakage:** They are sealed to **5 ACH50**. ACH50 means air changes per hour at a pressure difference of 50 pascals. [Release documentation, p. 11](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_2025_1.pdf#page=11)
- **Applicable share:** Approximately **92% of existing dwelling units**; the roughly 8% below 6 ACH50 are excluded. [Measure applicability documentation, p. 1](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96281.pdf#page=1)
